problem.title: Balance Ledger
problem.statementMarkdown: Build a small ledger across two levels. Keep your implementation as new requirements unlock.

levels.title: Deposits
levels.statementMarkdown: Implement deposit(amount). Add the positive amount to the running balance and return the balance. Each test begins with zero balance.

levels.title: Withdrawals
levels.statementMarkdown: Add withdraw(amount). Return false without changing balance when funds are insufficient; otherwise subtract amount and return true. Deposits must still work. Add clear() to reset the balance; it returns no value.

implementations.referenceSource: class Solution { private int balance=0; public int deposit(int amount){balance+=amount;return balance;} public boolean withdraw(int amount){if(amount>balance)return false;balance-=amount;return true;}  public void clear(){balance=0;}}

class Solution { private balance=0;deposit(amount:number):number {this.balance+=amount;return this.balance;}withdraw(amount:number):boolean {if(amount>this.balance)return false;this.balance-=amount;return true;}  clear():void {this.balance=0;}}

implementations.starterSource:
let balance = ref 0
let deposit amount = 0
implementations.referenceSource:
let balance = ref 0
let deposit amount = balance := !balance + amount; !balance
let withdraw amount = if amount > !balance then false else (balance := !balance - amount; true)
let clear () = balance := 0
